scope: CR-1b — the semantic layer rebuilt on the 77K checkpoint (owner-approved 2026-09-11).

design.corpus_selector: global --checkpoint {50k,77k}, default 77k. command_semantic and command_checkpoint branch on it; command_clean stays 50K (clean77k exists).
design.public_mode: build_cleaned_77k gained the same cached fallback build_cleaned_50k has: when the CoffeeReview restricted ledger is not reachable, the committed CLEANED_77K_* ledgers are served under the FROZEN_77K_COUNT guard. Without this the semantic layer could only be rebuilt on the machine holding the text, and CI could not reproduce it.
design.manifest_stamps: BATCH7_SEMANTIC_MANIFEST.json gains corpus_checkpoint and source_ledger; CURRENT_DATA_MANIFEST.json gains semantic_corpus_checkpoint, candidate_77k_snapshot, cleaned_77k_view and points canonical_current_* at the 77K ledgers. phase_status is left as the 50K/60K acquisition phase it names (test-current-descriptor-data pins it); the semantic corpus is stated as a separate fact.

result.determinism: semantic re-run in public mode reproduced all 16 semantic/benchmark outputs byte-identically.

stale_gate_audit_semantic_stage.concept_clusters_line_22: NOT a filter. normalization_authority != NO_GOVERNED_AUTHORITY only decides whether the authority string joins the cluster's set; atoms still count. 73% of CoffeeReview valid atoms are NO_GOVERNED_AUTHORITY (new forms) and clustered normally.
stale_gate_audit_semantic_stage.concept_cluster_id: all 26,726 valid CoffeeReview atoms carry a cluster id; concept_clusters keys on it, so none fall out.
stale_gate_audit_semantic_stage.verdict: no silent drop inside the semantic stage.

operator_measurement_error.what: First acceptance check searched for 'coffeereview' in source_family_support — a COUNT column — and reported 0 clusters containing the family, which would have read as a total silent drop.
operator_measurement_error.caught_by: the same call showed SEMANTIC_FORM_NODE +2,615 with 2,998 CoffeeReview nodes, which cannot coexist with zero clusters; the column was re-read (source_family_ids) before any conclusion was reported.
operator_measurement_error.rule: before reporting a zero, confirm the column semantics of the field being searched.

artifact_lineage_finding.the_real_stale_gate: artefact-level, not a filter. The owner-facing review artefacts are produced by stages pinned to earlier checkpoints:
artifact_lineage_finding.ONTOLOGY_GAP_REGISTER.tsv: written by generate-batch3/batch4 from the 30K corpus (2,052 rows; unchanged by CR-1b)
artifact_lineage_finding.CONCEPT_CLUSTER_V2.tsv: written by generate-batch6-semantic-corpus.main from the 40K sidecars (2,853 rows; unchanged)
artifact_lineage_finding.ONTOLOGY_CONSOLIDATION_V2.tsv: written by command_semantic from the declared checkpoint — this IS the 77K cluster layer (5,050 rows)
artifact_lineage_finding.schema: CONSOLIDATION_V2 and CONCEPT_CLUSTER_V2 share an identical 30-column header. GAP_REGISTER = the same base + 7 B4 enrichment columns (support_band, review_priority_score, neighbor_cluster_ids, normalization_authorities, gold/silver/bronze_assertion_count, per-purpose rights_*).
artifact_lineage_finding.consequence: CoffeeReview's 1,835 clusters exist in CONSOLIDATION_V2 but not in the file named ONTOLOGY_GAP_REGISTER that the owner's review packet is cut from. Phase 1 must read the 77K consolidation, or the register must be re-derived from it.

test_change.what: validate_benchmark() received the 50K atoms returned by validate_50k() and recomputed the union-find component graph from them, then compared to CROSS_FORM_BENCHMARK_SPLIT_MANIFEST.json, which benchmark_v2 now writes from 77K. The test conflated the sealed 50K checkpoint with the corpus the semantic layer is built on.
test_change.fix: graph atoms are resolved from BATCH7_SEMANTIC_MANIFEST.json['source_ledger'] (falling back to the 50K atoms when absent); validate_50k() and its 50K assertions are untouched.
test_change.owner_rule_applied: changed for the test's own design defect (a hard-coded corpus assumption), not to admit data; the 50K checks remain exactly as pinned.

next.CR-1b-ii: derive the owner review surface from the 77K consolidation: apply B4.review_packet's review_states filter and the 7 enrichment columns to ONTOLOGY_CONSOLIDATION_V2 (or regenerate ONTOLOGY_GAP_REGISTER from it). Bounded: the enrichment logic exists in generate-batch4-cleaned-30k; it needs the corpus parameterised like command_semantic.
next.CR-1c: purpose-rights matrix to the 77K families via batch6.purpose_rights; converge B4/batch6 rights tables.

next.F19_repair: fix build_semantic_counts to accept semantic-concept:sensory.* endpoints; measure the delta on the 120 cases and the 100-row owner packet before applying; add the non-zero guard.

downstream_lineage_refresh.trigger: ci-verify stage PRODUCT_INFERENCE_V0 failed: 'lineage input hash drift: ONTOLOGY_CONSOLIDATION_V2.tsv' — the product checkpoint pins sha256 of the consolidation and edge ledgers.
downstream_lineage_refresh.action: re-ran generate-product-inference-v0.py then generate-product-inference-v02.py in public mode (maintainer sequence). Only PRODUCT_INFERENCE_MANIFEST.json / PRODUCT_TASK_CONTRACT.json / SHA256SUMS (v0) and PRODUCT_INFERENCE_V0_2_MANIFEST.json (v0.2) changed — hash lines only. All product TSVs byte-identical.
downstream_lineage_refresh.why_byte_identical: NOT because the 77K layer carries nothing for the product: defect F19 (KNOWN_PIPELINE_DEFECTS) — the product generator's edge→concept join never resolves canonical concepts, so semantic support is 0 for all 20 candidates at both checkpoints. Diagnosed here, not repaired (separate owner decision; changes the offline checkpoint's scores).
